```{r}
# create centered scaled vars --------------------------------------------

#' Create centered variables (used in glms):
  #all except Yrs Trt
  pcri$Snow.sc <- c(scale(pcri$Snow))
  pcri$PrevAUGSecchi.sc <- c(scale(pcri$PrevAUGSecchi))
  pcri$Ice_off.sc <- c(scale(pcri$Ice_off))
  
  
#' split the early (.e) and peak (.p) data from p.cri and create datasets

  #drop the peak data from early set:
  pcri.e <- pcri
  names(pcri.e)
  pcri.e <- pcri.e %>%
    select(-JUNPcri, -DIFF.4.6)
  # # grab out a subset of the pcri foc data that include only the APR/MAY surveys
  # foc.e <- subset(foc, foc$month == "04" |
  #                   foc$month == "05")
  # foc.e[,1]
  
  # #test a match based on lake and year  
  # unique(pcri.e[,c("Lake", "Year")])
  # unique(foc.e[,c("lknamemv", "year")])
  # sort(unique(pcri.e$Lake))
  # sort(unique(foc.e$lknamemv))
  
  #combine lake and year to give a lk-yr field
  pcri.e$lake_year <- paste(pcri.e$Lake, pcri.e$Year, sep = "")
  
  
  # create peak season dataset ----------------------------------------------
  #drop earlyseason stuff from peak dataset
  pcri.p <- pcri
  pcri.p <- pcri.p %>%
    select(-APRMAYPcri, -DIFF.4.6)

#' combine lake and year to give a lk-yr field
  pcri.p$lake_year <- paste(pcri.p$Lake, pcri.p$Year, sep = "")
```

```{r consecutive years of trt}
# calculating consecutive years of treatment ------------------------------

  lag_matrix <- read_csv("~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/analysis/CLP DLNM/filtered_treatment_history_matrix.csv")

  
  pcri.e <- pcri.e %>%
    mutate(Lake.ID = as.numeric(Lake.ID))
  
  pcri.p <- pcri.p %>%
    mutate(Lake.ID = as.numeric(Lake.ID))

  lag_matrix <- lag_matrix %>%
    mutate(SURVEY_START = mdy(SURVEY_START))
    mutate(Year = year(as.Date(SURVEY_START)))
  
    
  # 1. Calculate cytrt inside lag_matrix
  lag_matrix <- lag_matrix %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      cytrt = {
        # Extract lag2 through lag8 as a vector for the current row
        lags <- c_across(lag2:lag8)
        
        # Find the index position of the first 0
        first_zero <- match(0, lags)
        
        # If no 0 is found, count all 1s; otherwise, count 1s before the first 0
        if (is.na(first_zero)) {
          sum(lags == 1)
        } else {
          sum(lags[1:(first_zero - 1)] == 1)
        }
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # 2. Join the calculated cytrt into pcri.e matching on DOW and Year
  pcri.e <- pcri.e %>%
    left_join(
      lag_matrix %>% 
        select(DOW, Year, cytrt) %>%
        distinct(DOW, Year, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = c("Lake.ID"= "DOW", "Year" = "Year") # Adjust column names if pcri.e uses lake_year/lkyr
    )
      
  
    

  
 ###same with pcri.e 
  lag_matrix <- lag_matrix %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      cytrt = {
        # Extract lag1 through lag8 as a vector for the current row
        lags <- c_across(lag1:lag8)
        
        # Find the index position of the first 0
        first_zero <- match(0, lags)
        
        # If no 0 is found, count all 1s; otherwise, count 1s before the first 0
        if (is.na(first_zero)) {
          sum(lags == 1)
        } else {
          sum(lags[1:(first_zero - 1)] == 1)
        }
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # 2. Join the calculated cytrt into pcri.e matching on DOW and Year
  pcri.p <- pcri.p %>%
    left_join(
      lag_matrix %>% 
        select(DOW, Year, cytrt) %>%
        distinct(DOW, Year, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = c("Lake.ID"= "DOW", "Year" = "Year") # Adjust column names if pcri.e uses lake_year/lkyr
    )
      
  
  
#' The YrsTrt measures in June surveys is correct 1; = Treated this year, However
#' the spring surveys should be asking about wheter they were treated last spring. Then
#' we need to calculate cumulative years of trt as years in addition to year one. 
#' This separates immediate and cumulative effects.
#' Option 2: Reaassign a value for consecutive years treated or untreated --
#'
```

```{r years untreated}

  # 1. Calculate yutrt inside lag_matrix
  lag_matrix <- lag_matrix %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      yutrt = {
        # Extract lag1 through lag8 as a vector for the current row
        lags <- c_across(lag1:lag8)
        
        # Find the index position of the FIRST treatment (1)
        first_trt <- match(1, lags)
        
        # If no 1 is found, set to NA; otherwise subtract 1 to get years elapsed
        if (is.na(first_trt)) {
          NA_integer_
        } else {
          first_trt - 1L
        }
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # 2. Join yutrt into pcri.e (deduplicating lag_matrix first to prevent extra rows)
  pcri.e <- pcri.e %>%
    left_join(
      lag_matrix %>%
        select(DOW, Year, yutrt) %>%
        distinct(DOW, Year, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = c("Lake.ID" = "DOW", "Year" = "Year")
    )
  
  
    # 1. Calculate yutrt inside lag_matrix
  lag_matrix <- lag_matrix %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      yutrt = {
        # Extract lag1 through lag8 as a vector for the current row

        # Find the index position of the FIRST treatment (1)
        first_trt <- match(1, lags)
        
        # If no 1 is found, set to NA; otherwise subtract 1 to get years elapsed
        if (is.na(first_trt)) {
          NA_integer_
        } else {
          first_trt - 1L
        }
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # 2. Join yutrt into pcri.p (deduplicating lag_matrix first to prevent extra rows)
  pcri.p <- pcri.p %>%
    left_join(
      lag_matrix %>%
        select(DOW, Year, yutrt) %>%
        distinct(DOW, Year, .keep_all = TRUE),
      by = c("Lake.ID" = "DOW", "Year" = "Year")
    )
```

```{r}
#Trte is  treated with herbicides targeting P. crispus in the previous year

  left_join(
    lag_matrix %>%
      select(DOW, Year, Trte = lag1) %>%
      distinct(DOW, Year, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = c("Lake.ID" = "DOW", "Year" = "Year")
  )
  
#nsamp is number of points surveyed for that PI survey

  left_join(
    PI_surveys %>%
      dplyr::select(DOW, year, nsamp) %>%
      distinct(DOW, year, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = c("Lake.ID" = "DOW", "Year" = "year")
  )


pcri.p <- pcri.p %>%

      dplyr::select(DOW, year, nsamp) %>%
      distinct(DOW, year, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = c("Lake.ID" = "DOW", "Year" = "year")
```

```{r I didnt really look at this}
  plotdat.p <- data.frame(lake = pcri.p$Lake, trt = pcri.p$Trt ,

                          foc = pcri.p$litfoc )  
  plotdat <- rbind(plotdat.e,plotdat.p)
  plotdat$lake <- factor(plotdat$lake, levels = unique(plotdat$lake[order(plotdat$year)]))
  plotdat$period <- factor(plotdat$period, levels = c("peak", "early"))
```
